objective: Read-only historical S0 analysis of shot tendency and measured Calendar Sim shooting frequency across player cohorts; create evidence-based design for later Human-controlled Phase A setting change verification.

source_binding.database: local WorldData v24 world-v24.sqlite, never uploaded
source_binding.existing_sample: historical one-month pre-task simulation, 238 league games; Lillard has 16 analyzed games

human_decisions: Human confirmed NO manually modified values during the historical month; existing games can serve as static S0 without re-simulation.
Current real game has NOT advanced during G1/G2 development; no S1 writing, post-intervention game, or effect verification exists.
Human alone triggers ordinary capture via Gemini, calendar simulation, and authorized gameplay changes.

Three Human-gated workflows: ordinary capture on explicit request; post-modification one-week simulation plus Human-triggered capture for persistence/safety; N-day simulation and Human-triggered capture for mechanism effect.
FULL refresh is allowed without new completed game; no new game requirement should be added to FULL.
Original large SQLite and backup files remain local; never Git-upload databases, compressed DB backups, raw memory or entire dumps.

scope.authorized: Read existing local SQLite and project code; create small deterministic queries, source-quality audit, stats and sanitized summaries; use existing WorldData and G1/G2 source evidence.
scope.prohibited: Any memory mutation, save file editing, game actions, calendar advancing, automatic or self-triggered game capture, resident scheduling, indiscriminate native research, uploading database or backups, master merge or Core canonical modifications.

workstream: Verify unique player ID and exact shot_tendency_raw mapping from native skill profile and current snapshot with provenance; no guesswork about Shot Tendency equals shooting volume.

Read existing 238 calendar games and all relevant player_game_boxes, join player identity + tendency + attributes + positions + teams and coach/team contextual data by existing WorldData safe query semantics; do not invent numeric zeros or force unavailable join keys.

Per-player eligible-game denominators, min thresholds, minutes, team FGA, score anomaly exclusion, injured/rotation change flags, source unit, snapshot observed_at and human-confirmed no manual changes; distinguish unknown engine-side variation.

Compute descriptive distributions, tendency bins that adapt to observed sample, FGA/36, FGA/team share, mean FGA vs tendency, source-aware correlation, cautious stratified/adjusted regressions only if sample supports, plus confidence intervals or honest limitations.

Specifically compare Damian Lillard to eligible lead guards/usage peers with genuine comparable controls; don't infer a -15 tendency effect from unmodified historical Lillard. Keep 3PA mechanism separate from overall shot tendency; if no field source, explicitly UNKNOWN.
Evaluate whether cross-player static evidence motivates the proposed 95->80 test; flag alternative targets/deltas as candidates, not changes.

Construct one focused next Phase A Human-run smoke plan WITHOUT executing it: authorized modification method to be confirmed by Human, one week of user simulation, Human triggers Gemini FULL capture, compare each target's expected current value to native/SQLite readbacks, distinguish persistence from gameplay effect.
Do not accidentally start Phase B; no automatic waiting loops or proactive remote DB calls.
acceptance: Every statistic traceable to actual query, source units and true eligible-player count; local SQLite unavailable -> explicitly DATA_NOT_AVAILABLE, no fabricated values.
Historical S0 unmodified per Human is accepted, but no dose response inferred from single player unchanged over month.
Score anomaly 222 exact and 16 discrepant; previous 228 figures were <=4 threshold, not <=3; provenance/cause classification remains evidence bounded.
No arbitrary causal claim or treating p>0.05 as null effect proven; uncertainty and confounding explicit.
One concise report and machine readable small anonymized/aggregated summary; DB and huge backups remain local.
Honest read-only Phase A readiness boundary and Human gate; not a setter or write authorization.

Structured Loop v0.1 observation per genuine bounded iterative round and actual stop causality; distinguish planned increments, test failure, Human feedback and no-evidence repeats, initial development vs post-delivery remediation.
Protect task branch only, no master/Core source writes.

loop_observability.per_iteration: trigger_type, trigger_ref, bounded_objective, action, evidence receipts and actual exit code, outcome delta, sha before/after, next decision
loop_observability.summary: valid internal rounds, trigger distribution, true improvements, regressions, post-delivery remediation separately, stop_class+evidence and Human resumption conditions
loop_observability.not_counted: commands, tests, stages, report writing alone, or no-new-evidence repeated attempts
